upcoming_earnings.ai_summary_en: TSM is scheduled to report earnings on 2026-10-15 with an EPS estimate of 4.46 and revenue estimate of 45.67B. The company has demonstrated a perfect historical beat rate of 1.0 in recent quarters. This upcoming release will provide insight into semiconductor foundry demand and AI-related growth.
